output.subject: Your message about the Riverside Dr ATM
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to tell us about the ATM at Riverside Dr. You told us the machine has been out of order for about two weeks and that its screen is cracked, and you asked whether anyone is working on fixing it.

We understand how inconvenient it is when a machine you rely on isn't available, especially for that long, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused. Feedback like yours helps us understand what customers are experiencing at our locations.

We have passed your message to our Branch & Contact Center team, who will look into the status of the ATM at Riverside Dr. We will respond to you within 10 business days with an update.

If you have any other details you'd like to share, such as when you last tried to use the machine or anything else you noticed, please reply to this message and we will add it to your complaint.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the current status of the Riverside Dr ATM and whether a repair is scheduled or completed.
Decide whether to share a repair timeline or nearby alternative ATM locations with the customer.
Check whether the cracked screen poses any safety or card-security concern that should be mentioned.
Check whether other customers have reported the same ATM outage.
